answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lantern of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
